remarks:
Here's your rare chance to own a spacious home on a quiet dead-end street in the Village of Oakfield — close to everything the village has to offer. The enclosed front porch lets you enjoy the outdoors while staying out of the weather.

Step through the front door into a welcoming foyer with a closet, which flows into the living room. From there, the dining room serves as the hub of the main floor, offering access to two of the downstairs bedrooms, a bathroom, the kitchen, and the stairway to the second floor.

The kitchen features a convenient eating area, and just off the kitchen you'll find the very large family room with a cozy fireplace. Beyond the family room is the first-floor laundry, along with the entrance to the full basement.

Upstairs, there's more than enough room for storage plus a second full bathroom — and the primary bedroom spans half of the entire upper level!
